product_family: AI-powered localization and translation management platform; products include Transifex TMS (translation management system), Transifex AI (LLM-driven translation with ZDR), Transifex Native (SDK for in-app localization), and TQI (Translation Quality Index)

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I
certifications.proof_quote: Transifex's SOC 2 Type I report did not have any noted exceptions and therefore was issued with a 'clean' audit opinion from SSF. The examination was performed by Sensiba San Filippo, LLP (SSF) and covered security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality and privacy.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: We have successfully completed a System and Organization Controls (SOC) 2 Type II audit performed by Sensiba San Filippo, LLP (SSF). Transifex's SOC 2 Type II report did not have any noted exceptions and therefore was issued with a 'clean' audit opinion from SSF. Official Transifex blog post published September 28, 2022 (echoed on the Transifex community forum October 4, 2022).

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification on any Transifex-domain page. Note: Transifex's security page lists AWS's ISO 27001 certification as their hosting provider's attribute, not Transifex's own.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: Transifex publishes a Data Processing Agreement, Standard Contractual Clauses, and a Sub-Processors list. The DPA states: 'We will act as a Processor of any Protected Data provided to Us in delivering the Services to You' and commits to 72-hour breach notification.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No HIPAA compliance claim on any Transifex-domain page. Transifex's security page mentions AWS hosting complies with HIPAA, but that is the host's certification, not Transifex's own posture.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Transifex does not store or process card data directly: 'We do not store any credit card information. All our credit card processing is taken care of by Chargebee and Stripe.' PCI DSS scope therefore lies with those processors, not Transifex.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27701 (privacy information management) certification on any Transifex-domain page.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 or any AI governance certification on any Transifex-domain page.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR registration or certification on any Transifex-domain page.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization on any Transifex-domain page.

privacy.ai_training_note: Transifex AI FAQ states: 'your data remains your data and is not used to train public models.' The platform uses Zero Data Retention (ZDR) with external AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini listed as sub-processors), meaning customer content is not retained by those providers for training purposes. Per-customer fine-tuning and RAG are described as the personalization mechanism. The privacy policy (last modified November 2024) does not contradict this but does not explicitly address AI training on customer data in its text.
privacy.data_region: AWS Ireland (EU) for primary hosting per security page; however the privacy policy states data 'may be viewed and hosted anywhere in the world' with no formal residency lock. No EU-only data residency option is documented publicly.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: SSL/TLS for all server-to-server and web app traffic; HTTPS enforced for all app-facing endpoints

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: File and database backups encrypted with AES (Advanced Encryption Standard)

security.name: Password storage
security.value: User passwords hashed with PBKDF2; no plaintext passwords stored

security.name: Infrastructure hosting
security.value: Amazon Web Services Ireland (EU region); all VMs on cloud with administrative access limited to authorized personnel

security.name: VPN
security.value: VPN required for restricted infrastructure access; VPN traffic always encrypted

security.name: Incident monitoring
security.value: 24x7 monitoring with a public status page at status.transifex.com; Twitter/X status handle @TransifexStatus

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure
security.value: Responsible disclosure via security@transifex.com with PGP encryption option; active bug bounty/researcher acknowledgment program

security.name: Credit card data handling
security.value: No card data stored; payment processing delegated to Chargebee and Stripe (PCI Level 1 service providers)

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Role-based access; physical office access restricted with security personnel; need-to-know policy

security.name: Code security
security.value: Code reviews before production deployment; regular audits against OWASP Top Ten; critical patches applied immediately

security.name: Authentication options
security.value: SSO (SAML), Two-Factor Authentication (2FA), social login (GitHub, LinkedIn, Google)

security.name: Data deletion post-termination
security.value: 30-day extraction window after contract termination; deletion within a reasonable period after that window

security.name: Audit rights
security.value: Customers may conduct annual audits of Transifex's security controls with 14 days notice; cost borne by customer unless material failure found

products.name: Transifex TMS
products.data_scope: Source strings and translated content uploaded by users; user account data; project metadata
products.notes: Core platform used by product, marketing, and dev teams. Integrates with 40+ tools. Content stored on AWS Ireland.

products.name: Transifex AI (TX AI)
products.data_scope: Customer content passed to external AI sub-processors (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini) with ZDR agreements; brand glossary and voice data stored per-customer
products.notes: ZDR feature ensures content is not retained by LLM providers for model training. Per-customer fine-tuning using customer's own content. RAG used for brand-context injection.

products.name: Transifex Native
products.data_scope: Strings served dynamically from Transifex CDN; no user PII processed by Native SDK itself
products.notes: Developer SDK enabling over-the-air translation updates without app release.

products.name: TQI (Translation Quality Index)
products.data_scope: Translated strings evaluated by AI quality scoring models
products.notes: Automates human review triage; allows AI translations to publish without human intervention when quality threshold met.

compare.pricing_model: Tiered SaaS (Starter free trial, growth/professional plans by volume of words/strings; enterprise pricing on request)
compare.data_residency: AWS Ireland (EU) by default; no documented customer-selectable data residency option; privacy policy allows global data hosting

flags: Transifex's own security page lists AWS's certifications (SOC 1/2/3, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS Level 1, FIPS-140-2, CSA, FERPA, FISMA Moderate) in a way that could mislead readers into thinking these are Transifex's own certifications. They are AWS's certifications, not Transifex's, and should not be read as held by Transifex itself.

The SOC 2 Type II announcement dates to September 2022 (official Transifex blog, September 28, 2022; community-forum echo October 4, 2022). SOC 2 Type II is typically renewed annually, and no public evidence of renewal reports beyond 2022 was found as of June 2026. The certification may still be current, as many vendors maintain it privately, but it cannot be confirmed from public sources.
Despite serving large enterprise clients (HubSpot, Celonis), Transifex has no publicly evidenced ISO 27001 certification. Procurement teams expecting ISO 27001 should request evidence directly.

Transifex claims zero data retention (ZDR) with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini. Whether formal ZDR API agreements are in place with each provider was not independently verified; the claim relies solely on Transifex marketing pages.

The security page implies AWS Ireland (EU) hosting, but the privacy policy states data may be hosted 'anywhere in the world.' No formal EU data residency commitment or customer-selectable region is documented.
